en.headline: AFCD to review Po Pin Chau trail booking after high no-show rate
en.dek: Only about 1,560 registered and walk-in visitors arrived over the first two trial days despite more than 3,200 bookings; the department will assess the system after the National Day golden week.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said it will review the new real-name reservation system for the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo Trail after large numbers of no-shows during the first two trial days.

On Saturday and Sunday, 3,230 people made bookings but only about 1,560 registered and walk-in patrons arrived. On Sunday alone, roughly 660 of 1,430 reservations turned up. The daily capacity is capped at 2,000 visitors in four two-hour slots between 9am and 5pm.

An AFCD spokesman said the department would step up visitor management, patrols and enforcement around the East Dam and Po Pin Chau area, continue publicity, and conduct a comprehensive review after the National Day golden week to help formulate longer-term countryside management strategies. Lawmakers and a district councillor have called for more on-site quotas and clearer information for walk-ins.

zh.headline: 破邊洲預約制首兩日大量No Show 漁護署將全面檢討
zh.dek: 首兩個試驗日共有逾三千二百人預約，實際到場約一千五百六十人；署方表示國慶黃金周後會檢視成效。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，萬宜水庫東壩破邊洲段新實名預約制首兩個試驗日出現大量預約後未有到場的情況，署方將在國慶黃金周後全面檢討。
周六及周日共有約3,230人預約，但實際登記及即場到場約1,560人。周日約1,430個預約中，只有約660人到場。每日名額上限為2,000人，分四個兩小時時段，上午9時至下午5時。
漁護署發言人表示，會加強東壩及破邊洲一帶的遊客管理、巡邏及執法，繼續宣傳教育，並在國慶黃金周後檢視試驗成效，以協助制訂長遠郊野管理策略。有議員及區議員建議增加即場名額及更清晰的即場資訊。
